parsed.rationale: The two initializers live in structurally distinct targets (`app:WatchXYC` / `WXYC/WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift` and `app:iOS` / `WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingWidget/NowPlayingTimelineEntry.swift`) and carry different type names (`NowPlayingEntry` vs `NowPlayingTimelineEntry`) with different external parameter labels (`_:` vs `nowPlayingItem:recentItems:family:`). The `fields_or_signature` arrays are both empty, so the Jaccard similarity of 0.78 is driven purely by structural shape rather than shared field or parameter content. Because the two types serve platform-specific widget/timeline roles (watchOS player page vs iOS WidgetKit timeline entry), any apparent similarity is coincidental to their respective platform contracts rather than evidence of extractable shared logic.
